raw_posts.name: Clara AI SDR
raw_posts.tagline: Turn website visitors into qualified pipeline
raw_posts.description: Clara is an AI SDR that converts inbound website traffic into pipeline - engaging, qualifying, demoing, handling objections, and booking meetings in real time. No forms. No waiting. No extra headcount. 24/7 selling with seamless CRM integration.

raw_posts.name: Taku AI
raw_posts.tagline: Borrow the best AI setups and make them yours.
raw_posts.description: AI is getting insanely powerful — and somehow harder to use. Taku fixes the last mile. It turns the best skills, agents, and workflows into real desktop apps anyone can run, remix, and make their own. Borrow setups from the pros, skip GitHub and setup, or just tell Taku what you want and watch it assemble the stack. The more you work, the more Taku learns what you need — and brings the right tools to you.

raw_posts.name: Superflow AI
raw_posts.tagline: AI agents that QA your website before launch
raw_posts.description: Superflow turns the QA checklist you already use into a team of AI agents. They sweep every page, desktop and mobile, and pin every finding on the live site. Agents handle the black and white issues. Taste stays with you. Agents learn: rejected findings stop coming back, and misses become checks on future sites. Teams say they catch ~90% of what they found by hand. Works with Webflow, Framer, WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, Netlify + more.

raw_posts.name: Hubble
raw_posts.tagline: Retrieve medical records other APIs can't
raw_posts.description: Medical records still live behind fax lines, phone trees, and portal logins nobody remembers. A patient verifies their identity once, and Hubble assembles their records from across their providers and returns them through one API, for your AI agent to use.

raw_posts.name: ElevenLabs MCP in Claude
raw_posts.tagline: Create and manage ElevenLabs voice agents in your chat
raw_posts.description: Connect Claude to your ElevenLabs workspace to create and manage voice agents. Find existing agents, review their configuration, update prompts and voices, duplicate or delete agents.

raw_posts.name: AirBuddy 3
raw_posts.tagline: Easily manage devices and switch them between Macs
raw_posts.description: AirBuddy 3 brings over 150 new features and improvements, including a new design, powerful new ways to keep an eye on your devices, deeper media integration, revamped Magic Handoff, and many new options for automation and customization.

raw_posts.name: Shepherd Terminal
raw_posts.tagline: A persistent terminal for Codex and Claude side by side
raw_posts.description: Run coding agents across tabs, panes, and remote machines. Shepherd keeps terminal sessions alive when the app closes, tracks which agents are working or waiting, and lets you return to their files and changes without losing context. Agents understand the current Shepherd context, control tabs and panes, and collect feedback through browser reviews, while you monitor every agent’s status in real time.

raw_posts.name: Reckon
raw_posts.tagline: The decision journal that helps you calibrate
raw_posts.description: Most decisions feel resolved the moment you make them. Reckon keeps what hindsight erases: the prediction, the confidence, the reasoning. Check-ins capture what changes before the outcome: new info tagged positive or negative, confidence updated. At resolution you log what happened; weeks later it asks if you'd still make the call. A year in, you see where confidence overshoots, where it undershoots, where judgment is sharpest. iPhone and iPad. iCloud sync, no account. One-time purchase.

raw_posts.name: Atlas by WorkOS
raw_posts.description: Atlas works alongside your team in Slack to answer questions, automate tasks, and help everyone do their best work.

raw_posts.name: Finch
raw_posts.tagline: A single place for your health data and tests
raw_posts.description: Finch is a patient-side health companion built for all — an expecting parent, or just someone navigating the health system. Pregnancy alone involves at least 12 appointments, dozens of test results, and a new vocabulary, coming from different providers in different formats. That's just one example. Whatever your journey, Finch brings it into one clear view, transcribes what was said at your appointments, and translates clinical language into plain English. Free tier available. Finch+ $99/y
